label: The Lolly studios
caption: Seventeen covers, one app: Lolly at work and the files it makes, in a different colourway from card to card.

covers.name: Lolly Darkroom
covers.promise: Film looks, LUTs and grading for photos
covers.alt: A lorikeet with a lollipop, open in the Lolly Darkroom, its chrome in the red earth of the Afternoon colourway

covers.name: Lolly Filter
covers.promise: Halftone, dither, duotone, ASCII and more, on a picture or live camera
covers.alt: The Lolly logo as a halftone dot screen in fuchsia on pink, exported as SVG

covers.name: Lolly Chart
covers.promise: Paste a table and get a chart in your palette, flat or in 3-D
covers.alt: Glass 3-D bars in blue, brown and orange on a night stage, open in Lolly Chart

covers.name: Lolly Certificate
covers.promise: For a course, an award or a thank-you, signed, dated and sealed
covers.alt: A certificate of completion with an orange border and seal, exported as SVG

covers.name: Snippet
covers.promise: Code as a card: syntax highlighted, in your theme, ready to post
covers.alt: A TypeScript snippet card highlighted in pink on a plum ground

covers.name: Lolly QR code
covers.promise: A QR code in your colours and shapes, from a link, a card or a Wi-Fi network
covers.alt: A QR code for lolly.tools with leaf-shaped corners, rounded modules shading from ink to violet and the Lolly mark in the middle, in a Scan me badge on pale cyan, exported as SVG

covers.name: Lolly 3D Studio
covers.promise: Words, artwork and models in one lit scene, still or moving
covers.alt: The word Lolly as iridescent 3D letters hovering in a deep blue studio while the camera sweeps

covers.name: Lolly Assets
covers.promise: Every file, font and colour in one place
covers.alt: Lolly's two-tone icons painted in the Afternoon colourway's coral and red, in the Assets view

covers.name: Lolly Design
covers.promise: Free-form layouts on an open canvas, held to the design system
covers.alt: The Lolly Design canvas with a poster that asks Have you met Lolly?, in Lolly's own green

covers.name: Music generator
covers.promise: Pick a genre, shape the tune and keep the track, with every setting in the link
covers.alt: The music generator on two phones on a honey ground: a Spanish guitar track laid out section by section, and the genre picker

covers.name: Audiogram
covers.promise: A clip becomes a finished video that moves with the sound, MilkDrop included
covers.alt: A MilkDrop visualiser filling the frame to a loop, in a sky-blue brand, with the track title centred

covers.name: Lolly Colour Lab
covers.promise: One colour, reported in full: contrast, harmonies, screen and print
covers.alt: The Lolly Colour Lab's report on a violet, with its colour wheels and swatches

covers.name: Colours
covers.promise: Colours and colourways on a real colour wheel, kept in step everywhere
covers.alt: The Colours room of the design system studio with the Beach colourway chosen and a poster in its colours

covers.name: Street map
covers.promise: Any city as a poster, its streets in your colours
covers.alt: Amsterdam's streets and canals as a poster: red streets and olive canals on sand

covers.name: Lolly Logo Wall
covers.promise: Sponsors and partners in tiers, each logo sized to sit evenly with the rest
covers.alt: A sponsor wall of placeholder wordmarks in three tiers on honey yellow, open in Lolly Logo Wall

covers.name: Lolly Sequence
covers.promise: Lolly Design's video timeline: clips, music and voiceover, cut in place
covers.alt: The Sequence timeline under a pink title card that reads What's new, in a plum app

covers.name: Utilities
covers.promise: Lolly Scan, Lolly Verify, Lolly Redact, Lolly Unpack and the everyday file jobs, in the app
covers.alt: The Utilities shelf in slate and violet, with Verify & Inspect, Unpack, Compare and Spreadsheet among the tiles, captured as vector
